A unit test pins that a stand-in with extra text is rejected and an exact one accepted (extend tests/unit/scripts/test_oracle_review_check.py if not already covered).
Document, or fix, that both oracle-review runs must be rerun after a stand-in or thread resolution.
description: docs/agent/merge-authority.md says to quote the owner's instruction in the stand-in comment, but _project/scripts/oracle_review_check.py matches the whole comment body against 'Stand-in oracle review: APPROVE <sha>' (fullmatch), so any extra text makes the attestation invalid. A comment with a quote failed during PR #3139 and cost two check cycles. Related: the two oracle-review runs (synchronize, submitted) each need a manual rerun after a stand-in or thread resolution.
